hook: RTX Spark: up to 128 GB memory, 1 PFLOP AI — plus 3

items.claim: GitHub says early testing shows Gemini 4 Argon solving more coding tasks than earlier Gemini models on every coding benchmark
Apple HomeView combines smart‑home dashboard, audio, and video on a 7‑inch display
Gemini 4 Argon is built to be an active research partner, DeepMind says
NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute

caption: NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops bring up to 128 GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute. Plus Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot, Apple HomeView, and DeepMind's research partner. Which is worth trying first?
alt_text: Slide 1: NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB memory and 1 PFLOP AI compute, plus 3 more. Slide 2: GitHub says early testing shows Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot solving more coding tasks than earlier Gemini models. Slide 3: Apple HomeView offers a 7‑inch smart‑home display with audio and video. Slide 4: DeepMind says Gemini 4 Argon is built to be an active research partner. Slide 5: NVIDIA says RTX Spark laptops have up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute.

Gemini 4 Argon: DeepMind dice que Gemini 4 Argon está diseñado para ser un socio activo de investigación
